purpose: Extend the six-commodity C5 monthly rotation study from 2015 with explicit pre-listing proxies, without overwriting the 2022 actual-ETF run.

selection.score: exp(250 * OLS(log(close), time, 25).slope) - 1, multiplied by OLS R-squared
selection.decision: previous close; first common session of each month executes at open
selection.rank2_buffer: hold if prior holding remains in top2, z(R2) leader gap <=0.25, and EFF25/B252 vetoes do not reject candidate

160723.XSHE.return_rule: USO close-to-close return mapped to the next known China-session return; no intraday China price claim

159980.XSHE.return_rule: equal-weight constituent overnight and intraday returns; sector path rebuilt from returns

159981.XSHE.return_rule: equal-weight available constituent overnight and intraday returns; MA joins after first observation

splicing.level: scale actual ETF open on first actual session to previous proxy close
splicing.switch_cost: 10bp when the same strategy node is held across the proxy-to-ETF switch; normal turnover remains charged by the C5 ledger

TIP.rule: use previous completed month; <=0 moves risk sleeve to 511260

overlays.DD8r7c50: after TIP, drawdown <=-8% halves risk; recovery at -7%

metrics.bootstrap: 21-day circular block, 10,000 draws, BH across registered comparisons
metrics.reconciliation: proxy splice vs actual ETF overlap after 2022-08-05

result_summary.tip_s_vs_u13612: TIP S point estimate exceeds U13612, but the paired Sharpe difference is not statistically confirmed

decision.reason: The DD overlay scores same-day returns before cutting same-day exposure. Event audit finds this materially inflates results; the strategy requires a next-session execution rebuild before further interpretation.
